senses.sense_definition: An organized massacre or violent riot targeting a particular ethnic or religious group, historically especially Jews.

examples.text: Thousands of families fled their homeland after surviving a devastating <w>pogrom</w> in the late nineteenth century.
The local authorities failed to stop the violent <w>pogrom</w> that destroyed the town's minority quarter.

senses.sense_definition: A deadly antisemitic hate crime or attack resulting in heavy casualties.

examples.text: News commentators described the horrific mass shooting at the community center as a modern <w>pogrom</w>.
The community gathered to mourn the victims of the recent <w>pogrom</w> and demand justice.

senses.sense_definition: To persecute, violently attack, or massacre a specific ethnic or religious group.

examples.text: Armed mobs attempted to <w>pogrom</w> the minority population during the breakdown of civil order.
Corrupt officials encouraged factions that <w>pogromed</w> defenseless communities in the border region.
